items.title: Is AI taking entry-level jobs? What the hiring data shows
items.pt:
Three studies published in 2026 now measure what AI is doing to the bottom of the career ladder, and they agree on something narrower than the headlines. Companies that adopt AI are adding senior people faster than junior ones, and young workers in the most exposed occupations are being hired less. None of the three found a wave of entry-level layoffs.

items.pt: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
